answer: Each new agent must lock a bond of 500 tokens in a public trellis contract for ten epochs before its grades count. A violet flag marks any account whose bond came from a wallet linked to another bonded account, so splitting one purse across many fakes is caught and those bonds are frozen. An attacker wanting 100 fake graders must tie up 50,000 tokens and wait ten epochs with no income, a cost that keeps rising toward the horizon. An honest agent pays once and gets the full bond back when it exits clean.
